name: demure
blurb: "Very demure, very mindful": Jools Lebron's 2024 TikTok joke about being modest and classy
title: Demure Meaning: What "Very Demure, Very Mindful" Means
description: Demure means modest and reserved. In 2024 TikToker Jools Lebron's "very demure, very mindful" videos made it a joke word for acting classy, and Dictionary.com's Word of the Year.
answer: Demure traditionally means reserved, quiet or modest. In August 2024 TikTok creator Jools Lebron turned it into a catchphrase with videos about how she behaves at work, saying she is "very demure, very mindful". Online, "demure" now jokingly means looking or acting refined and appropriate, often about something that is not demure at all, and Dictionary.com named it its 2024 Word of the Year.

sections.h: Where "very demure, very mindful" comes from
body: On 2 August 2024 Lebron posted a short TikTok titled "How to be Demure at Work", showing how she does her hair and makeup for the office. A follow-up a few days later, built around the line "very demure, very mindful", took off: within weeks her videos had tens of millions of views and she appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live! on 19 August. The bit works because it is deadpan: she describes ordinary choices as if they were the height of refinement.

body.note: The Independent and others read the trend as a gentle parody of influencer "clean girl" and etiquette content.

head: Date
Event
rows: Jools Lebron posts "How to be Demure at Work" on TikTok.
Her "very demure, very mindful" follow-up goes viral; remixes and copycat videos spread to X and Reddit.
Lebron guests on Jimmy Kimmel Live!; searches for "demure" on Dictionary.com pass 13 million in a week.
Brands and organisations, including NASA, post their own "demure" jokes; a stranger files to trademark the phrase, and Lebron later files her own trademarks.
Dictionary.com names "demure" its Word of the Year.

ul: "Wore a cardigan to the meeting. Very demure, very mindful."
Ironically: "Ate a whole pizza alone in my car. So demure."
As a mild call-out: "Screaming at the referee is not very demure of you."
Stretching the formula: "very cutesy", "very mindful", "very respectful".

sections.h: Similar trends and is it still used?

head: Trend
Vibe
Difference
rows: A fashion look, not a catchphrase

body: The peak was August to November 2024. Today "very demure, very mindful" reads as a slightly dated but widely understood joke, and the plain word demure is back to being a normal English word with a playful extra meaning.

faq.a: TikTok creator Jools Lebron, in videos posted in August 2024 about how she presents herself at work.
In its original sense, yes: it means modest and reserved. In meme use it is usually playful or ironic rather than a real compliment.
di-MYOOR, with the stress on the second syllable.
